title: Slingbox railworkshop: a modular console navigation & workspace hub proposal
creator: Maya Chen
description: High-level proposal for a modular sidebar + workspace hub that reduces context switching and surfaces rollout & cost lenses closer to task flows. This ticket captures the research summary, design rationale, prototype links, and the current list of unresolved trade-offs for engineering and PM review. Goal: land an IA shape and keyed interaction specs that Eng can implement as a feature flagged rollout for early customers.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic sidebar layout that supports role-aware lanes (Admin / Developer / Observer) and persists last-used workspace per user.
Workspace hub component that shows: active workspace, quick-switch history (most recent 7), pinned projects, and a lightweight cost lens toggle with 3-minute refresh.
A rollout controls panel reachable from primary nav that dovetails with existing Rollouts API; enabling canary rules must be visible and editable by PMs.
Prototype annotated with interaction states (hover, focused, collapsed), keyboard shortcuts, and accessible labels (ARIA) documented.
Design handoff artifacts for top two priority flows (switch workspace, open rollout panel) uploaded to FigJam and linked to a tracked PR.
decisions: Keep top-left app icon + product selector; introduce a compact 'workspace chip' to the left of primary nav instead of the full workspace dropdown to reduce vertical space.
Adopt progressive disclosure for cost lenses: collapsed (sparkline + last-minute delta), expanded (full per-route cost breakdown).
Use role-aware lanes rather than fully customizable nav for v1 to keep tradeoffs small and predictable for Dedicated/Private customers.
Keyboard-first switcher: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens an inline quick-switcher that respects workspace affinity and recent history; full modal deferred to v2.
comments: 2025-11-10 Maya Chen: Initial sketch and problem statement uploaded. Observed that current sidebar takes >30% of vertical space on 13" laptops. Hypothesis: compact workspace chip reduces vertical density and increases time-to-task.

2025-11-11 Andre Rivera: Reviewed component boundaries — asking for clarity on persistent state across sessions and whether workspace affinity should be sticky or ephemeral. Follow-up: Need API contract for 'last_used_workspace' sticky field.

2025-11-12 Lina Ahmed: Engineering feasibility: suggested limiting initial animation complexity; prefer CSS transitions + reduced DOM churn. Raised concern about exposing cost metrics requiring new backend telemetry endpoints.

2025-11-13 Evan Patel: PM feedback: prioritize rollouts integration — must show canary status and toggle in the rollout panel surface. Also requested a compact 'snooze alerts' quick action on the hub.
2025-11-14 Accessibility review (Automated): flagged color contrast on collapsed cost sparkline for WCAG AA; suggested adjusting palette and adding textual delta for screen readers.

2025-11-15 Priya Rao: Design review: approved IA flow but asked for two alternative microcopy options for workspace chip and explicit affordance for multi-tenant users. Action: A/B test copy in prototype.

2025-11-16 Andre Rivera: Engineering estimate update — 5 points for feature-flagged implementation of sidebar + workspace chip + quick-switcher. Rollout panel integration + cost endpoints are separate tickets (see dependencies).
2025-11-17 Maya Chen: Uploaded annotated Figma with keyboard patterns and ARIA attributes. Added edge-case handling for >200 workspaces: collapsible 'More' grouping and search shortcut.
2025-11-18 Lina Ahmed: Noted added GitHub PR that wires the new navigation reducer. Left inline review comments on the accessibility labels and telemetry batching logic.
open_questions: Telemetry cadence: should cost lens update at 30s, 3m, or 5m intervals by default? (Engineering prefers 3m for cost).
Session affinity: when moving between regions, do we persist last-used workspace per-region or global?
Rollout authoring: does the console manage rollouts only or will it also surface suggested fallback models? (scope implication for backend).
next_steps: Lock microcopy for workspace chip and run A/B in prototype (owner: Maya) — due 2025-11-21.
ENG to provide telemetry contract for cost lens (owner: Lina) — due 2025-11-24.
PM to scope rollout panel API changes and update PM spec (owner: Evan) — due 2025-11-20.
Prepare design tokens and accessibility color updates for handoff (owner: Design Operations) — due 2025-11-22.
